qa_pair.question: In the riff.quest exercise library, look at the easy exercises that train legato and have a tab the microphone scores. Which of them goes up to the highest top tempo (maximum metronome BPM)? Answer with its exercise id.
The library exercise titled "Spider — One Note Per Beat": on which string does its last measure begin? Answer with the string's letter as written on a guitar tab (e, B, G, D, A or E).
The library exercise "Spider — Shifting Up the Neck" is mostly in 4/4. Which other time signature appears in its tab?
In riff.quest's exercise taxonomy, which skill category has the most guitar skills? Answer with the category name.
According to the riff.quest wiki, what accuracy does a run need to count as clean in a tempo goal set to Relaxed? Answer as a percentage, like 50%.
According to the riff.quest wiki, how many missed days a week can a player have as rest days without losing their streak? Answer with a number.
Using riff.quest's tab checker, write one 6/8 measure made only of dotted quarter notes on the open low E string, so that it passes the check. How many notes does that measure have?
At what tempo does the library exercise "Spider — String Skipping" recommend starting? Answer with the BPM number.
Among the library exercises whose title starts with "Spider" and whose only skill is finger independence, which one goes up to the fastest maximum tempo? Answer with its exercise id.
The library exercise "Meter — 3/4 ↔ 5/8" alternates two meters. How many of the measures in its tab are in 5/8?
